scope: Wrangler 4.54.0 trusted runtime Wasm module deployment lifecycle
assertions: no_bundle plus find_additional_modules discovers the Wasm import
CLI deploy uploads binary module and execution returns 42
CLI redeploy changes only the binary and execution returns 7
compatible API content download preserves exact non-UTF-8 bytes and application/wasm MIME after both deploys
namespace secret mutation preserves Wasm and assets
ordinary dispatcher secret lifecycle and serving remain valid
adaptations: Namespace secrets use the compatible API: Wrangler 4.54.0 lacks namespace secret options.
Binary content download is verified by the compatible API, not a Wrangler download command.
Customer deletion uses native administration; namespace and ordinary dispatcher deletion use Wrangler.
notes: Memory repository, local object storage and loopback-only fixture.
The retained first Linux failure occurred before API calls because copied Darwin dependencies lacked Linux platform packages.

An isolated temporary Linux dependency tree retains the pinned lock versions; four platform package tarballs were checked against locked SHA-512 integrity before extraction. No repository dependency/version changes.
Wrangler eagerly resolves its bundled workerd 1.20251210.0 platform package; the serving runtime is separately pinned to workerd 2026-09-11.
Container uses no network, non-root, read-only package/root mounts, 1 GiB memory and 128-task bounds. These do not qualify per-invocation isolation.
